tasks.first-due-hint.note: Hint under 'First time' for a task counted from when it was last done.

tasks.every-days.note: How often a task counted from when it was last done is due, in the list of tasks. 'About' because it follows when it's really done.

tasks.how-due.note: Label in the list of tasks, next to a bar from 'just done' to 'due' and its state in words.

tasks.due-today.note: The state next to the bar: the task is due today.

tasks.due-in.note: The state next to the bar: days until the task is due. Days the household is away don't count.

tasks.overdue.note: The state next to the bar: days since the task became due.

tasks.invalid-every-count.note: Why adding or saving a task didn't work: the number in 'Due again after' is not a whole number from 1 up to a year.

tasks.invalid-every-unit.note: Why adding or saving a task didn't work: no unit was chosen in 'Due again after'.

tasks.when.note: Legend of the choice between doing a task any time in its plan week or at set times around each date (ADR-0004 §4).

tasks.when-week.note: Choice: the task can be done any day of the plan week its date falls in.

tasks.when-set.note: Choice: the task is done within a window of set times around each date, such as putting the bins out the evening before collection.

tasks.window.note: Legend of a task's set times, and their label in its details.

tasks.window-hint.note: Hint under the set times, with the example of bins collected on a Wednesday morning.

tasks.window-from-day.note: Label of the day the window starts on, relative to the task's date: “the day before”, “the day itself”…

tasks.window-from-time.note: Label of the time the window starts at.

tasks.window-to-day.note: Label of the day the window ends on, relative to the task's date.

tasks.window-to-time.note: Label of the time the window ends at; it ends before this time.

tasks.day-itself.note: A window's day: the task's date itself. Lower case, as it is also used inside “From {from} at …”.

tasks.day-before.note: A window's day: the day before the task's date. Lower case.

tasks.day-after.note: A window's day: the day after the task's date. Lower case.

tasks.days-before.note: A window's day: {count} (2 or 3) days before the task's date. Lower case.

tasks.days-after.note: A window's day: {count} (2 or 3) days after the task's date. Lower case.

tasks.window-words.note: A task's set times in words. {from} and {to} are days such as “the day before”; {fromTime} and {toTime} are times as HH:MM.

tasks.invalid-when.note: Problem: neither choice of when the task is done was sent.

tasks.invalid-window.note: Problem with a task's set times: missing, more than 3 days from its date, or ending before they start.

tasks.advanced.note: The choice of how often a task is done for a schedule built from rules and dates in the advanced editor (ADR-0004 §3).

schedule.weeks.note: A rule of an advanced schedule, inside a sentence (it starts lower case). {days} lists weekdays, such as 'Monday and Thursday'.

schedule.months.note: A rule of an advanced schedule, inside a sentence (it starts lower case). {day} is a day of the month, 1 to 31.

schedule.weekdays-of-month.note: A rule of an advanced schedule, inside a sentence (it starts lower case), such as 'every 2nd and 4th Tuesday of the month'. {which} lists words like '2nd' or 'last'; {day} is a weekday.

schedule.year.note: A rule of an advanced schedule, inside a sentence (it starts lower case). {date} is a day and month, such as '3 March'.

schedule.first.note: Which of a weekday in its month, as in 'every 1st Monday of the month'.

schedule.second.note: Which of a weekday in its month, as in 'every 2nd Tuesday of the month'.

schedule.third.note: Which of a weekday in its month, as in 'every 3rd Wednesday of the month'.

schedule.fourth.note: Which of a weekday in its month, as in 'every 4th Thursday of the month'.

schedule.last.note: Which of a weekday in its month, as in 'every last Friday of the month'.

schedule.on.note: An advanced schedule made of extra dates only, in a sentence (it starts lower case). {dates} lists days.

schedule.also-on.note: The extra dates of an advanced schedule, after its rules, separated by a semicolon. {dates} lists days.

schedule.not-on.note: The exception dates of an advanced schedule, after its rules, separated by a semicolon. {dates} lists days.

schedule.rules.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Legend of the group of rules.

schedule.rules-hint.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Hint under the rules' legend.

schedule.rule.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Legend of one rule; {number} counts from 1.

schedule.kind.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Label of the choice of what kind of rule it is.

schedule.kind-weeks.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). A kind of rule.

schedule.kind-months.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). A kind of rule: it repeats on the day of the month of its first time.

schedule.kind-weekdays-of-month.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). A kind of rule, such as the 2nd and 4th Tuesday.

schedule.kind-year.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). A kind of rule: it repeats on the day and month of its first time.

schedule.every.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Label of the number of weeks or months between dates; 1 is every week or month.

schedule.days.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Legend of the weekdays a rule every few weeks falls on.

schedule.which.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Legend of the choice of 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th or last of a weekday.

schedule.weekday.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Label of the weekday of a rule on a weekday of the month.

schedule.start.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Label of the first date of a rule.

schedule.start-hint.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Hint under a rule's first time.

schedule.remove-rule.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Button that removes one rule.

schedule.add-rule.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Button that adds a rule.

schedule.extra-dates.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Legend of the days the schedule adds.

schedule.extra-dates-hint.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Hint under the extra dates' legend.

schedule.extra-date.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Label of one extra date; {number} counts from 1.

schedule.remove-extra.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Button that removes one extra date.

schedule.add-extra.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Button that adds an extra date.

schedule.exception-dates.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Legend of the days the schedule leaves out.

schedule.exception-dates-hint.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Hint under the dates to leave out.

schedule.exception-date.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Label of one date to leave out; {number} counts from 1.

schedule.remove-exception.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Button that removes one date to leave out.

schedule.add-exception.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). Button that adds a date to leave out.

schedule.in-words.note: The advanced schedule editor in the form that adds or changes a task (ADR-0004 §3). The schedule read back in plain words, under the editor; {words} is a sentence such as 'Every Wednesday; not on 11 November 2026'.

tasks.invalid-rules.note: Why the rules of an advanced schedule were refused (ADR-0004 §3).

tasks.invalid-extra-dates.note: Why the extra dates of an advanced schedule were refused (ADR-0004 §3).

tasks.invalid-exception-dates.note: Why the exception dates of an advanced schedule were refused (ADR-0004 §3).

tasks.shared.note: Shared schedules in the form that adds or changes a task, and in the list (ADR-0004 §1). A choice of how often a task is done: on the schedule of another task, such as bringing the bins in on the days they go out.

tasks.shared-with.note: Shared schedules in the form that adds or changes a task, and in the list (ADR-0004 §1). Label of the choice of the task whose dates it shares; in the list, the label before the tasks it shares them with.

tasks.shared-note.note: Shared schedules in the form that adds or changes a task, and in the list (ADR-0004 §1). Note on the form of a task that shares its dates; {tasks} lists task names.

tasks.own-dates.note: Shared schedules in the form that adds or changes a task, and in the list (ADR-0004 §1). Checkbox on the form of a task that shares its dates: new dates for this task alone.

tasks.invalid-shared-with.note: Shared schedules in the form that adds or changes a task, and in the list (ADR-0004 §1). Why the choice of whose dates to share was refused.

task.who.note: Who does a task, on the task's page, which only heads see (ADR-0001 §3). Legend of the group with the minimum age and the constraints.

task.who-hint.note: Who does a task, on the task's page, which only heads see (ADR-0001 §3). Hint under the legend.

task.minimum-age.note: Who does a task, on the task's page, which only heads see (ADR-0001 §3). Label of the task's minimum age.

task.minimum-age-hint.note: Who does a task, on the task's page, which only heads see (ADR-0001 §3). Hint under the minimum age.

task.constraint-none.note: Who does a task, on the task's page, which only heads see (ADR-0001 §3). A member's constraint: none, they take it when they fit.

task.constraint-bound.note: Who does a task, on the task's page, which only heads see (ADR-0001 §3). A member's constraint: the task is always theirs.

task.constraint-excluded.note: Who does a task, on the task's page, which only heads see (ADR-0001 §3). A member's constraint: the task is never theirs.

task.constraint-allowed.note: Who does a task, on the task's page, which only heads see (ADR-0001 §3). A child's constraint: they may take it though they are younger than its minimum age.

tasks.invalid-minimum-age.note: Who does a task, on the task's page, which only heads see (ADR-0001 §3). Why the minimum age was refused.

tasks.invalid-constraints.note: Who does a task, on the task's page, which only heads see (ADR-0001 §3). Why the constraints were refused.

task.linked-to.note: Same-person links between tasks (ADR-0001 §7). Label of the choice of the task whose next occurrence goes to the same member, on the task's page.

task.linked-to-hint.note: Same-person links between tasks (ADR-0001 §7). Hint under the choice.

task.linked-to-none.note: Same-person links between tasks (ADR-0001 §7). The choice of no linked task.

tasks.linked-to.note: Same-person links between tasks (ADR-0001 §7). Label in the task list before the linked task's name.

tasks.invalid-linked-to.note: Same-person links between tasks (ADR-0001 §7). Why the link was refused.

areas.page-title.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Browser tab title of the areas page.

areas.title.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Heading of the areas page.

areas.intro.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Introduction on the areas page.

areas.none.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). When the household has no areas.

areas.name.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Label of an area's name.

areas.add.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Heading of the form that adds an area, and its button.

areas.added.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Status after an area is added.

areas.rename.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Button that saves an area's new name; {name} is its name now.

areas.renamed.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Status after an area is renamed.

areas.remove.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Button that removes an area; its tasks are left without one.

areas.removed.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Status after an area is removed.

areas.invalid.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Why an area's name was refused.

areas.taken.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Why an area's name was refused: another area has it, whatever the case.

areas.failed.note: A household's areas (ADR-0001 §1). Heading of the summary when adding, renaming or removing an area didn't work.

areas.back.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Link from the areas page back to the tasks.

tasks.areas.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Link from the tasks page to the areas page.

tasks.area.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Label of a task's area in its form.

tasks.no-area.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). A task without an area: the choice in its form, and the heading of such tasks in the list.

tasks.invalid-area.note: A household's areas, rooms or parts of the home that group its tasks (ADR-0001 §1). Why a task's area was refused.

tasks.one-offs.note: Heading of the list of one-off tasks on the tasks page (ADR-0004 §4).

tasks.one-off-done.note: Beside a one-off task in the list that was done this plan week; it stays listed until the next plan week begins (ADR-0006 §3, clarification).

tasks.one-off-week.note: When a one-off task without a deadline is done: any day of the plan week of its day. {day} is a date, such as “14 October 2026”.

tasks.add-one-off.note: Heading of the form that adds a one-off task, which every member with an account sees, children included (ADR-0006 §3).

tasks.add-one-off-intro.note: Under the heading of the one-off form: what a one-off task is for, and that everyone may add one.

tasks.one-off-name-hint.note: Hint under the name of a one-off task. Keep the example a small chore done once.

tasks.one-off-date.note: Label of a one-off task's day, in its form and its details.

tasks.one-off-date-hint.note: Hint under a one-off task's day: it is planned somewhere in that day's plan week, not necessarily on the day.

tasks.one-off-deadline.note: Label of a one-off task's optional last day; up to it, the task can float into a quiet week (ADR-0004 §4).

tasks.one-off-deadline-hint.note: Hint under the optional last day of a one-off task.

tasks.add-one-off-submit.note: Button that adds the one-off task.

tasks.add-one-off-failed.note: Heading of the error summary when adding a one-off task was refused.

tasks.invalid-deadline.note: Problem with a one-off task's last day: before its day, or more than a year away.

task.invalid-deadline.note: Problem with a one-off task's last day when changing it: it may keep the day it has, which may have passed.

task.remove-one-off-intro.note: On the page that confirms removing a one-off task: removing it is logged for the whole household (ADR-0018 §5, clarification).

plan.times-label.note: The plan page: label of a task's set times (ADR-0004 §4), which everyone sees (ADR-0018 §3).

plan.times.note: The plan page: a task's set times; {from} and {to} are a weekday and a time, such as 'Tuesday 18:00'.

plan.add-one-off.note: Link on the plan page to the tasks page's form for a one-off task, which starts on today (ADR-0006 §3, clarification).

activity.one-off-added.note: Activity log entry: a member added a one-off task, such as 'Fix the shelf' (ADR-0006 §3). {actor} is a name, or “A former member”. {task} is the task's name as the member typed it, never translated. {who} picks the wording: 'you' when the reader did it, '*' otherwise (ADR-0018 §5, clarification).

activity.one-off-removed.note: Activity log entry: a member removed a one-off task. {actor} is a name, or “A former member”. {task} is the task's name as it was, never translated. {who} picks the wording: 'you' when the reader did it, '*' otherwise (ADR-0018 §5, clarification).
